# Ashutosh Writes

> Ashutosh Writes is a boutique research-led writing studio for fintech and AI-security teams, led by Ashutosh Mahapatra in Bhubaneswar, India. We write long-form articles researched to primary sources, with on-page SEO, GEO and AEO built in, and content strategy. Every article ships with a source ledger. We do not do full-site SEO audits or volume content.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://ashutoshwrites.online/): What the studio does, the source-ledger standard, research samples and who the studio is for.
- [Services](https://ashutoshwrites.online/services): On-page SEO, GEO and AEO, research-led articles, content strategy, and the free Article Check.
- [Method](https://ashutoshwrites.online/method): The five-step process, the six-field source ledger, and what we test instead of promising rankings or citations.
- [Work](https://ashutoshwrites.online/work): Four self-directed writing samples in fintech and AI security, none of them client work, each built with on-page SEO, GEO and AEO.
- [Research](https://ashutoshwrites.online/research): The independent research articles, plus how we audited our own site for AI-crawler visibility.
- [About](https://ashutoshwrites.online/about): The three-person writing and engineering team.
- [Free Article Check](https://ashutoshwrites.online/contact): Send one article and receive a written claim-verification and AI-citation report.
- [Author: Ashutosh Mahapatra](https://ashutoshwrites.online/author/ashutosh-mahapatra): Biography, coverage areas and an archive of every published article.

## Articles

- [Shadow AI Inside Approved SaaS: How Agents Inherit Access](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/shadow-ai-inside-approved-saas): How vendor-embedded AI agents inherit OAuth scope from platforms already approved, what EchoLeak, Drift and Vercel prove and do not prove, dated EU AI Act obligations, and a governance framework for security teams.
- [Visa Already Decided Who Eats the Loss When Your AI Agent Buys the Wrong Thing](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/visa-agentic-commerce-disputes): Who bears the loss when an AI agent buys the wrong thing, checked against primary rule text.
- [How AI is Rewiring Personal Finance in 2026: The Data, the Tools, and What Most Coverage Gets Wrong](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/ai-personal-finance-2026): Sourced statistics, structural trends and the risks most AI-finance coverage misses.
- [AI Took Over the Internet. Now Audiences Are Revolting, and Human Creators Are Winning.](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog/ai-vs-human-content-2026): What ranking and audience data show about AI-generated versus human-written content.
